title: Verify a CPIO entry checksum when the caller reads into a slice
summary: The CPIO reader accepted checksum 132 after delivering unsigned bytes 1, 128 and 3 at a nonzero offset. Both one-byte read patterns preserved their prefix and reached the following entry.

change.description: Accumulate unsigned entry bytes from the destination offset supplied to CpioArchiveInputStream.read.

notes: Both pins use the same Commons IO snapshot rebuilt from e19519ad1a61ec6852601d28ffe94a8967e4e3e0.
